open_points.subject: Activation after trial-corpus growth
open_points.text: “Read by activation, which requires an `admitted` verdict over the current corpus.” / “The current activation of a contract version is the one recorded last.”
open_points.question: When adding or capturing a trial case grows the corpus after an implementation was activated, does that activation remain current and runnable even though its verdict covers an older corpus?
options: The activation remains current and runnable until another activation replaces it.
The activation record remains, but it is no longer eligible for new runs until the implementation is admitted over the enlarged corpus.
Corpus growth automatically runs admission again and either preserves or removes eligibility according to the result.
open_points.default_guess: Keep the historical activation record but make the contract version unavailable to new runs until an implementation is admitted over the enlarged corpus.

open_points.subject: Cancel a run with work in progress
open_points.text: “cancel a run | owner | the run ends `cancelled`; nothing further is sent | a finished run cannot be cancelled” / “status: `running`, `awaiting_approval`, `pending`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `refused` or `cancelled`”
open_points.question: What happens when the owner cancels a `running` run while a function execution or service invocation is already in progress, and what NodeExecution or EffectAttempt facts and statuses record that work?
options: Cancellation is accepted only at a scheduling boundary after current work concludes.
The kernel interrupts active work and records a cancellation outcome, requiring a corresponding node-attempt status.
The run becomes `cancelled` immediately, while already-started work may conclude and be recorded afterward.
Active work is allowed to finish, but its result is discarded before the run becomes `cancelled`.
open_points.default_guess: Stop scheduling new work, wait for already-started work to reach a truthful recorded outcome, then make the run `cancelled`.

open_points.subject: Recovery of an in-flight effect
open_points.text: “The record written before an effect is sent, so that a crash or an unclear answer leaves a known unknown instead of a silent one” / “`in_flight` → `applied` | `not_applied` | `not_sent` | `unknown`”
open_points.question: On restart, what product action or lifecycle rule converts an EffectAttempt found in `in_flight` into a recoverable run state, and which Run, WaitingPoint and NodeExecution statuses result?
options: Recovery changes it to `unknown`, records an `outcome_unknown` node execution and waiting point, and makes the run `pending`.
It remains `in_flight` and blocks the run until an owner or operator performs another action.
Recovery resends it automatically using its idempotency key.
open_points.default_guess: Convert it to `unknown`, record `outcome_unknown`, and leave the run `pending` for the owner's resolution.
